Islands On The Air，英国 RSGB 主办的海岛通联奖状计划。: Islands On The Air: an island award programme run by the RSGB of Great Britain.
与海岛台通联以收集岛组，满足奖状要求。: Works island stations to collect groups and meet the award requirements.
全球海岛按地理分组编号，如 AS-xxx（亚洲）、OC-xxx（大洋洲）。: Islands worldwide are numbered in geographical groups, e.g. AS-xxx (Asia), OC-xxx (Oceania).
岛组编号与 DXCC 实体不同，同一实体可能有多个岛组。: Group references differ from DXCC entities — one entity may contain several groups.
海岛台呼号常带 /P（便携/登岛）；/MM 表示海上移动，不属海岛设台。通联前确: Island stations often use /P (portable / on the island); /MM means maritime mobile and is not island operation. Confirm the group reference before the contact.
登岛设台的电台，可激活岛组并积累积分。: A station that lands on an island and operates, activating the group and accumulating points.
稀有岛组远征同样会形成 pileup，遵守分裂操作礼仪。: Rare island DXpeditions also create pile-ups, so observe split operating etiquette.
记录岛组编号，配合日志软件与奖状追踪工具。: Record the group reference, using logging software and award tracking tools.
通联规定数量的岛组可获得 IOTA 奖状与奖牌。: Working the required number of island groups earns the IOTA award and medals.
